hook.convey: a 4-digit number met in daily life (stadium crowd, game score) → it has 4 places: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones → reading and writing it = one digit per place

explain.convey: 4 places hazaar | sau | dahaai | ekai, one digit each; 7465 → 7 thousands, 4 hundreds, 6 tens, 5 ones → read place by place from the left

point.hi: Dekho, 7465 mein 4 ank hain, aur har ank ki apni jagah hai: hazaar, sau, dahaai, ekai. Hazaar ki jagah 7, sau ki jagah 4, dahaai ki jagah 6, aur ekai ki jagah 5. Isliye ise padhte hain saat hazaar chaar sau painsath.
point.en: Look, 7465 has 4 digits, and each digit has its own place: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones. 7 in the thousands place, 4 in the hundreds place, 6 in the tens place, and 5 in the ones place. So we read it as seven thousand four hundred sixty-five.

say.hi: Abacus par 4 teeliyan hain: hazaar, sau, dahaai, ekai. Hazaar par 5 mani, sau par koi nahi, dahaai par 2, ekai par 7. Khaali teeli ke liye 0 likhte hain, toh number 5027 hai, 527 nahi.
say.en: The abacus has 4 spikes: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones. 5 beads on thousands, none on hundreds, 2 on tens, 7 on ones. For the empty spike we write 0, so the number is 5027, not 527.

simpler.hi: Khaali teeli ke liye 0 likho. Hazaar 5, sau 0, dahaai 2, ekai 7, toh number 5027 hai.
simpler.en: Write 0 for the empty spike. Thousands 5, hundreds 0, tens 2, ones 7, so the number is 5027.

prompt.hi: Abacus 4 teeliyon wala hai: hazaar mein 8 mani, sau mein 3, dahaai mein koi nahi, ekai mein 4. Number kya hai?
prompt.en: The abacus has 4 spikes: 8 beads on thousands, 3 on hundreds, none on tens, 4 on ones. What is the number?

why.hi: abacus ki 4 teeli: hazaar par 8 mani, sau par 3, dahaai par koi nahi toh 0, ekai par 4 hain: 8304
why.en: the abacus has 8 thousands, 3 hundreds, no tens so 0, and 4 ones: 8304

simpler.hi: Har teeli ek jagah hai: hazaar mein 8, sau mein 3, ekai mein 4. Khaali dahaai wali teeli ki jagah shunya likho.
simpler.en: Each spike is one place: 8 in thousands, 3 in hundreds, 4 in ones. Write zero for the empty tens spike.

bridgeToNext.hi: Abhi dekha ki khaali jagah par 0 likhna padta hai. Ab aise numbers likhenge jinke beech mein zero hain, aur unhe har jagah ki value mein khol kar likhenge, jise expanded form kehte hain.
bridgeToNext.en: We just saw that an empty place needs a 0. Next we write numbers with zeros inside them, and open them up into the value of each place, which is called the expanded form.

simpler.hi: Khaali jagah par 0 likhna hum dekh chuke. Agle hisse mein beech mein zero wale numbers likhenge aur unhe har jagah ki value mein kholenge.
simpler.en: We have seen that an empty place gets a 0. Next we write numbers with zeros inside, and open them into the value of each place.

hook.convey: a zero inside a number holds an empty place; drop it and the number shrinks (3060 → 36); in the expanded form that place adds nothing

use.hi: Video game mein tumhara score 3060 hai. Agar zero hata diye toh score 36 reh jaayega, bahut kam. Aaj dekhenge ki number ke beech ka zero kitna zaroori hai.
use.en: Your video game score is 3060. If the zeros are dropped, the score becomes 36, far less. Today we see how important a zero inside a number is.

use.hi: Train ke ek ticket ka number 7009 hai. Beech ke do zero hata do toh number 79 ban jaata hai, jo bilkul alag ticket hai.
use.en: A train ticket's number is 7009. Drop the two zeros in the middle and the number becomes 79, a completely different ticket.

explain.convey: chaar hazaar pachaas: no hundreds → the hundreds place is empty but present → 0 holds it → 4050; without the 0 the 5 slides into hundreds → 450

point.hi: Chaar hazaar pachaas mein hazaar ki jagah 4, sau ki jagah khaali, dahaai 5, ekai 0. Khaali sau ki jagah par 0 likhte hain, toh number 4050 hai. Zero hata do toh 450 bachta hai, jo sirf chaar sau pachaas hai.
point.en: In four thousand fifty the thousands place has 4, the hundreds place is empty, tens 5, ones 0. We write 0 in the empty hundreds place, so the number is 4050. Drop that zero and 450 is left, which is just four hundred fifty.

prompt.hi: Teen hazaar chhe ko numbers mein likho.
prompt.en: Write three thousand six in numbers.

why.hi: hazaar 3, khaali sau aur dahaai mein 0, ekai 6 aata hai: 3006; zero hata do toh number badal jaata hai
why.en: 3 thousands, 0 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones make 3006, just as dropping 4050's zeros gives 450

simpler.hi: Hazaar ki jagah teen hai aur ekai ki jagah chhe. Beech ki sau aur dahaai ki jagah khaali hai, wahan 0 likho.
simpler.en: Thousands has three and ones has six. The hundreds and tens places in between are empty, so write 0 there.

explain.convey: seven thousand eighty: 7000 and 80 stuck side by side → 700080, 6 digits, too many; a number in the thousands has only 4 digits → 7 | 0 | 8 | 0 → 7080

point.hi: Seven thousand eighty ko 7000 ke aage 80 chipkaakar 700080 likhna galat hai, isme 6 ank ho gaye. Hazaar wale number mein sirf 4 ank hote hain: 7 hazaar, 0 sau, 8 dahaai, 0 ekai, yaani sahi number 7080.
point.en: Writing seven thousand eighty as 700080, with 80 stuck after 7000, is wrong: that has 6 digits. A number in the thousands has only 4 digits: 7 thousands, 0 hundreds, 8 tens, 0 ones, so the right number is 7080.

prompt.hi: Nine thousand forty ko numbers mein likho.
prompt.en: Write nine thousand forty in numbers.

why.hi: 9 hazaar, 0 sau, 4 dahaai, 0 ekai se sahi number 9040 banta hai, 4 ank ka; 700080 jaisa 6 ank galat
why.en: like 7080, 9040 needs just 4 digits: 9 thousands, 0 hundreds, 4 tens, 0 ones

simpler.hi: Hazaar wale number mein sirf 4 ank hote hain. Nine thousand forty mein sau ki jagah khaali hai, aur forty se chaar dahaai milte hain.
simpler.en: A number in the thousands has only 4 digits. Nine thousand forty has an empty hundreds place, and forty gives four tens.

explain.convey: expanded form = each digit's value written separately; 6305 → 6000 + 300 + 5, 6035 → 6000 + 30 + 5; a zero place gives no part

point.hi: Expanded form mein har ank ki value alag likhte hain. 6305 mein 3 sau ki jagah par hai, toh 6000 + 300 + 5. 6035 mein 3 dahaai ki jagah par hai, toh 6000 + 30 + 5. Zero wali jagah ka hissa likhte hi nahi.
point.en: In the expanded form we write each digit's value separately. In 6305 the 3 is in the hundreds place, so 6000 + 300 + 5. In 6035 the 3 is in the tens place, so 6000 + 30 + 5. The zero place gives no part at all.

prompt.hi: 8070 ka expanded form kaunsa hai: 8000 + 70 ya 8000 + 700?
prompt.en: Which is the expanded form of 8070: 8000 + 70 or 8000 + 700?

why.hi: 8070 mein 8 hazaar ki jagah aur 7 dahaai ki jagah par hai, toh 8000 + 70

simpler.hi: 8070 mein har ank ki jagah dekho. Daayen se pehli jagah ekai hai, doosri dahaai, teesri sau.
simpler.en: Look at the place of each digit in 8070. From the right, the first place is ones, the second tens, the third hundreds.

problem.hi: Six thousand forty-two ko numbers mein likho.
problem.en: Write six thousand forty-two in numbers.

simpler.hi: Pehle six thousand ko hazaar ki jagah rakho, phir forty-two ko. Beech ki khaali jagah mat bhoolna.
simpler.en: First put six thousand in the thousands place, then forty-two. Do not forget the empty place in between.

givens.hi: Number shabdon mein diya hai: six thousand forty-two.
givens.en: The number is given in words: six thousand forty-two.

do.hi: 4 khaane banao aur six thousand ke liye hazaar wale khaane mein ank likho
do.en: Make 4 boxes and write the digit for six thousand in the thousands box

why.hi: six thousand matlab 6 hazaar
why.en: six thousand means 6 thousands

simpler.hi: 4 khaane banao. Six thousand ka matlab 6 hazaar, toh hazaar ke khaane mein 6 likho.
simpler.en: Make 4 boxes. Six thousand means 6 thousands, so write 6 in the thousands box.

do.en: Now look at the hundreds place

why.hi: six thousand forty-two mein koi sau nahi hai, aur khaali jagah 0 se bharte hain
why.en: six thousand forty-two has no hundreds, and an empty place is filled with 0

simpler.hi: Six thousand forty-two mein hundred wala koi hissa nahi hai. Khaali sau ki jagah mein 0 likho.
simpler.en: Six thousand forty-two has no hundred part. Write 0 in the empty hundreds place.

prompt.hi: Ab forty-two ko dahaai aur ekai mein rakho. Poora number kya bana?
prompt.en: Now put forty-two into the tens and the ones. What is the whole number?

simpler.hi: Forty-two mein chaar dahaai aur do ekai hain. Unhe dahaai aur ekai ke khaanon mein rakho.
simpler.en: Forty-two has four tens and two ones. Put them in the tens and ones boxes.

why.hi: shabdon mein se hazaar ki jagah 6, sau mein 0, aur forty-two se dahaai 4, ekai 2 aata hai: 6042
why.en: six thousand forty-two gives 6 thousands, 0 hundreds, 4 tens and 2 ones: 6042

answer.hi: six thousand forty-two ko 6042 likhte hain

why.hi: hazaar mein 6, sau mein 0, dahaai mein 4 aur ekai mein 2, har jagah ek ank
why.en: 6 in thousands, 0 in hundreds, 4 in tens and 2 in ones, one digit in each place

prompt.hi: Ek gaon ki aabaadi paanch hazaar nau hai. Yeh number ankon mein likho.
prompt.en: A village has a population of five thousand nine. Write this number in digits.

why.hi: paanch hazaar nau mein hazaar ki jagah 5, sau aur dahaai 0, aur ekai 9 hai, toh aabaadi 5009 hai
why.en: five thousand nine has 5 thousands, 0 hundreds, 0 tens and 9 ones: 5009

simpler.hi: Hazaar ki jagah paanch aur ekai ki jagah nau aayega. Beech ki sau aur dahaai ki jagah khaali hai, wahan shunya likho.
simpler.en: Thousands gets five and ones gets nine. The hundreds and tens places in between are empty, so write zero there.

prompt.hi: {friend} ne eight thousand sixty ko 800060 likha. Sahi number kya hai?
prompt.en: {friend} wrote eight thousand sixty as 800060. What is the right number?

why.hi: 8 hazaar, 0 sau, 6 dahaai, 0 ekai se sahi number 8060 banta hai; 800060 likha toh 6 ank ho gaye
why.en: eight thousand sixty has 8 thousands, 0 hundreds, 6 tens, 0 ones: 8060, just 4 digits

simpler.hi: Hazaar wale number mein sirf chaar ank hote hain. Sixty se chhe dahaai milte hain, aur khaali jagah par shunya aata hai.
simpler.en: A number in the thousands has only four digits. Sixty gives six tens, and an empty place gets a zero.

prompt.hi: 5608 ke expanded form mein 6 ka hissa kya hoga: 600 ya 60?
prompt.en: In the expanded form of 5608, what is the part for the 6: 600 or 60?

why.hi: 5608 mein 6 sau ki jagah par hai, toh expanded form mein 6 ka hissa 600 hai
why.en: in 5608 the 6 is in the hundreds place, so its part is 600

simpler.hi: 5608 mein 6 kis jagah par hai, woh dekho. Daayen se pehli jagah ekai, doosri dahaai, teesri sau.
simpler.en: See which place the 6 is in 5608. From the right, the first place is ones, the second tens, the third hundreds.

ladder.why: four thousand fifty → 4050; zero holds the empty hundreds
predict the digit count of six thousand seven → 4 digits, two zeros inside
error spot: 500020 for five thousand twenty → 5020
explain why 4050 needs its zero → without it 450

remediation.move: abacus with 4 spikes: do hazaar aath built as 2 beads, empty, empty, 8 → both empty spikes get a 0 → 2008; beside it the zeros dropped → 28

say.hi: Do hazaar aath mein hazaar par 2, sau aur dahaai khaali, ekai par 8. Dono khaali jagah par 0 likhte hain, toh 2008. Zero chhoda toh 28 ban jaata hai, jo sirf atthaees hai.
say.en: In two thousand eight, thousands has 2, hundreds and tens are empty, ones has 8. Both empty places get a 0, so 2008. Leave the zeros out and it becomes 28, which is just twenty-eight.

simpler.hi: Khaali sau aur dahaai mein 0 likho: hazaar 2, phir 0, 0, aur ekai 8. Toh 2008 banta hai, 28 nahi.
simpler.en: Put 0 in the empty hundreds and tens: thousands 2, then 0, 0, then ones 8. So it is 2008, not 28.

prompt.hi: Aath hazaar teen ko ankon mein likho. Har khaali jagah par 0 aayega.
prompt.en: Write eight thousand three in digits. Every empty place gets a 0.

why.hi: aath hazaar teen mein hazaar 8, khaali sau aur dahaai ki jagah 0, ekai 3 aata hai: 8003
why.en: eight thousand three has 8 thousands, 0 hundreds and 0 tens, and 3 ones: 8003

simpler.hi: Hazaar ki jagah aath aur ekai ki jagah teen aayega. Sau aur dahaai ki jagah khaali hai, wahan 0 likho.
simpler.en: Thousands gets eight and ones gets three. The hundreds and tens places are empty, so write 0 there.

remediation.move: 4-box chart again: two thousand thirty → 2 | 0 | 3 | 0 → 2030; 2000 and 30 stuck side by side → 200030, too many digits for a number under ten thousand

say.hi: Hazaar wale number ke sirf 4 khaane hote hain. Two thousand thirty mein hazaar 2, sau 0, dahaai 3, ekai 0, toh 2030. 2000 ke aage 30 chipkaakar 200030 likhna galat hai.
say.en: A number in the thousands has just 4 boxes. In two thousand thirty: thousands 2, hundreds 0, tens 3, ones 0, so 2030. Writing 200030, with 30 stuck after 2000, is wrong.

simpler.hi: Sirf 4 khaane bharo: hazaar 2, sau 0, dahaai 3, ekai 0. Toh two thousand thirty 2030 hai.
simpler.en: Fill just 4 boxes: thousands 2, hundreds 0, tens 3, ones 0. So two thousand thirty is 2030.

prompt.hi: Five thousand seventy ko numbers mein likho, sirf 4 khaanon mein.
prompt.en: Write five thousand seventy in numbers, in just 4 boxes.

why.hi: 5 hazaar, 0 sau, 7 dahaai aur 0 ekai se 5070 banta hai, sirf 4 khaane mein
why.en: five thousand seventy has 5 thousands, 0 hundreds, 7 tens and 0 ones: 5070 in 4 boxes

simpler.hi: Sirf 4 khaane banao. Five thousand se hazaar ka khaana bharo, seventy se saat dahaai, aur khaali jagah par shunya.
simpler.en: Make just 4 boxes. Five thousand fills the thousands box, seventy gives seven tens, and the empty place gets zero.
